videos.title: Roblox's Giant Tower Event Ends Soon! 🧱 #roblox #shorts
videos.description:
The Great Build is Roblox's own Thanksgiving event: place one free block every hour in a shared community tower, and place 5 blocks to claim the free items when the tower hits each goal. It ends Nov 30, so check the in-game countdown. Times are in Eastern Time and can change.

videos.title: Roblox News Today: The Great Build, Adopt Me Gingerbread Mansion & 4 New Codes 🚨 #roblox
videos.description:
Today's Roblox news: The Great Build, Roblox's own Thanksgiving tower event, ends Nov 30 (one free block every hour, place 5 blocks to claim milestone prizes), Adopt Me's Nov 27 Gingerbread Mansion update brought snow plus the new Hooray (Ultra Rare) and Tilcayo (Legendary) pets, and creators can now keep pixel art sharp with the new Pixelated resample mode for decals, textures and meshes. Plus 3 games have 4 new codes.

1:23 Coming Up + Outro

Codes in this video:
RIVALS: FREE208 (3 Keys; follow the developers first)
Anime Crusaders X: HAPPYTHANKSGIVINGAC (Gems + Trait Remnants; amounts vary by source)
Overflow: 3000LIKES (20 Style Rolls + 20 Passive Rolls + 5 Variant Rerolls + 10 Race Rerolls), 2500LIKES (15 Style Rolls + 15 Passive Rolls + 5 Race Rerolls)

Codes may expire at any time, so redeem them fast! Event times are in Eastern Time and can change.
